name: Love Your Enemy
overview: Scripture calls believers to a radical love that extends even to their enemies, as Jesus commands in Matthew 5:44 and Luke 6:27 to love, bless, and pray for those who oppose us. This love reflects the heart of God, who demonstrated His love by Christ's sacrificial death for sinners (Romans 5:8). Instead of seeking personal revenge, believers are urged to trust God's righteous judgment (Romans 12:19), embodying the peacemaking character that identifies them as God's children (Matthew 5:9). This teaching challenges natural inclinations and reveals the transformative power of Christ-centered love.
